items.title: Quinnipiac: Shapiro 59%, Garrity 34% in PA governor race; voters favor Dems to win House control by 15 points
items.summary: Quinnipiac University poll of 1,159 PA likely voters (fielded Oct 1-5, 2026, MoE +/-3.9) released Oct 7, 2026: Gov. Josh Shapiro (D) leads GOP challenger Stacy Garrity 59%-34%, with Libertarian Ken Krawchuk at 2%. Shapiro job approval 63%; 56% satisfied with how things are going in PA. Same poll: voters favor Democrats to win control of the U.S. House by 15 points; Trump disapproval 60%. RCP average (Sept 15-Oct 5) has Shapiro +23.2 (56.0 vs 32.8); Cook rates Solid D, Sabato Likely D. (Missed by earlier runs; catch-up item.)
